ConnectionStrings._comment: Do NOT store the connection string here. Supply it at runtime as the Azure App Service connection string named 'DefaultConnection', as the environment variable ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection, or via 'dotnet user-secrets set' when developing locally.

SeedEmployee._comment: Credentials for the initial Employee account created at start-up. Set these as App Service application settings SeedEmployee__Email and SeedEmployee__Password, or as user secrets. Leave blank in source control.
